purpose: offline model of the instrument-cluster navigation rectangle

canvas.evidence: observed built-in and HDMI display dimensions in saved Android captures; CarPlay configuration also specifies 800x480
canvas.orientation: landscape (inferred from width greater than height and captured frames)

candidateNavigationImageRegion.evidence: inferred from Honda Hack meter_civic.xml: root is 584x215 and screen_cast image fills a match-parent child with 24px top padding
candidateNavigationImageRegion.confidence: medium for the Honda Hack cast rectangle; low as a proxy for the factory Navigation safe rectangle

rendering.scalePolicy: fit viewport while preserving 584:191 aspect ratio
rendering.pixelFormat: unknown at the Android-to-meter transport; saved PNG captures are RGB screenshots
rendering.orientationTransform: none in the offline logical canvas; physical rotation/mirroring not independently measured

transport.physicalMeterTransport: not fully reconstructed; do not infer the pixel protocol from these components alone
